Name: tr_ComputeQuantity
Definition:
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[tr_ComputeQuantity] 
 ON [dbo].[InventoryTransferLog] 
 After Insert 
 AS 
 Begin 
 DECLARE @RetryCounter INT
 DECLARE @Retrylimit INT
 SET @RetryCounter = 1
 SET @RetryLimit = 50
 
 RETRY: -- Label RETRY
 BEGIN TRANSACTION
    BEGIN TRY
        Declare @InsertedItemID as int
        Declare @InsertedTimeStamp as timestamp
        Declare @InsertedQuantity as float 
        
        Select @InsertedItemID = ItemID, @InsertedTimeStamp = DbTimeStamp from Inserted with (NoLock)
        
        Select @InsertedQuantity = Item.Quantity from Item with (NoLock) where Item.Id = @InsertedItemID 
        
        Update InventoryTransferLog set InventoryTransferLog.ComputedQuantity = @InsertedQuantity
        where inventoryTransferlog.ItemID = @InsertedItemID
        and InventoryTransferLog.DbTimeStamp = @InsertedTimeStamp
        Commit Transaction
    End TRY
    Begin Catch
       ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
       DECLARE @DoRetry bit; -- Whether to Retry transaction or not
       DECLARE @ErrorMessage varchar(500)
       SET @doRetry = 0;
       SET @ErrorMessage = 'tr_ComputeQuantity' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
       IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 Or ERROR_NUMBER() = 1204 or ERROR_NUMBER() = 1222 -- Deadlock Error Number
       BEGIN
           SET @doRetry = 1; -- Set @doRetry to 1 only for Deadlock
       END
       IF @DoRetry = 1
       BEGIN
           SET @RetryCounter = @RetryCounter + 1 -- Increment Retry Counter By one
           IF (@RetryCounter > @RetryLimit) -- Check whether Retry Counter reached to 3
           BEGIN
               RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) -- Raise Error Message if 
                   -- still deadlock occurred after Max limit retries
           END
           ELSE
           BEGIN
               WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.20' -- Wait for 5 ms
               GOTO RETRY  -- Go to Label RETRY
           END
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1)
       END
   End Catch     
 End

Name: tr_ItemDeleted
Definition:
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[tr_ItemDeleted] ON [dbo].[Item] FOR DELETE
 AS
 DECLARE @Rows INT
 SELECT @Rows = @@ROWCOUNT
 IF @Rows = 0 /* No rows deleted, exit trigger */
 Return
 INSERT INTO RecordDeletedLog (TableName, IDFieldName, RecordID, WhenDeleted)
 SELECT 'Item', 'ID', ID, GetDate() FROM DELETED
 DELETE FROM ItemValueLog WHERE ItemValueLog.ItemID in (SELECT ID from DELETED)

Name: tr_ItemValueLog
Definition:
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[tr_ItemValueLog] ON [dbo].[Item]
AFTER Update
AS
Begin
 Declare @InsertedItemId as Int
 DECLARE @RetryCounter INT
 DECLARE @Retrylimit INT
 SET @RetryCounter = 1
 SET @RetryLimit = 50
 
 RETRY: -- Label RETRY
 BEGIN TRANSACTION
 
 BEGIN TRY
 
    IF (UPDATE(COST))
    Begin
    if not exists(select ItemID from ItemValueLog with (NoLock) Where ItemID in (Select ID from INSERTED with (NoLock)) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ItemValueLog.LastUpdated ,111) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),111) and ItemValueLog.AmountType = 'C')
        Begin
        if @@rowcount = 0
            Begin
            Declare @StoreID1 as int
            Select @StoreID1 = StoreID from Configuration with (NoLock)
            INSERT INTO ItemValueLog (ItemID,StoreID,OldAmount,NewAmount,AmountType,LastUpdated)
            Select Item.ID,@StoreID1,Deleted.Cost,Item.Cost,'C',GetDate() from ITEM with (NoLock)
            inner join Deleted on Item.ID=Deleted.ID
            Where Item.ID in (Select Inserted.ID from INSERTED)
            End
        End
    Else
        Begin
            Declare @InsertedCost as float
            select @InsertedCost= Inserted.Cost, @InsertedItemId = Inserted.Id from Inserted with (NoLock)
            
            UPDATE ItemValueLog set ItemValueLog.NewAmount = @InsertedCost, ItemValueLog.LastUpdated = getDate()
            where ItemValueLog.ItemID = @InsertedItemId
            and CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ItemValueLog.LastUpdated ,111) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),111)
            and (ItemValueLog.NewAmount <> @InsertedCost) and ItemValueLog.AmountType = 'C'
        End
    End
    IF (UPDATE(PRICE))
    Begin
    if not exists(select ItemID from ItemValueLog with (NoLock) Where ItemID in (Select ID from INSERTED) and CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ItemValueLog.LastUpdated ,111) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),111) and ItemValueLog.AmountType = 'P')
        Begin
        if @@rowcount = 0
            Begin
                Declare @StoreID2 as int
                Select @StoreID2 = StoreID from Configuration with (NoLock)
                
                INSERT INTO ItemValueLog (ItemID,StoreID,OldAmount,NewAmount,AmountType,LastUpdated)
                Select Item.ID,@StoreID2, Deleted.Price ,Item.Price,'P',getdate() from ITEM with (NoLock)
                INNER JOIN Deleted on Item.ID = Deleted.ID
                Where Item.ID in (Select Inserted.ID from INSERTED)
             End
        End 
    Else
        Begin
            Declare @InsertedPrice as float
            select @InsertedPrice= Inserted.Price, @InsertedItemId = Inserted.Id from Inserted with (NoLock)
            
            UPDATE ItemValueLog set ItemValueLog.NewAmount = @InsertedPrice , ItemValueLog.LastUpdated = GetDate()
            where ItemValueLog.ItemID = @InsertedItemId and CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ItemValueLog.LastUpdated,111) =  CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),GETDATE(),111)
            and (ItemValueLog.NewAmount <>@InsertedPrice) and ItemValueLog.AmountType = 'P'
        End
     End
     COMMIT TRANSACTION
  End Try
  Begin Catch
   ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
   DECLARE @DoRetry bit; -- Whether to Retry transaction or not
   DECLARE @ErrorMessage varchar(500)
   SET @doRetry = 0;
   SET @ErrorMessage = 'tr_ItemValueLog' + ERROR_MESSAGE()
   IF ERROR_NUMBER() = 1205 or Error_Number()= 1204 or Error_Number()= 1222-- Deadlock Error Number
   BEGIN
       SET @doRetry = 1; -- Set @doRetry to 1 only for Deadlock
   END
   IF @DoRetry = 1
   BEGIN
       SET @RetryCounter = @RetryCounter + 1 -- Increment Retry Counter By one
       IF (@RetryCounter > @RetryLimit) -- Check whether Retry Counter reached to 3
       BEGIN
           RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1) -- Raise Error Message if 
               -- still deadlock occurred after three retries
       END
       ELSE
       BEGIN
           WAITFOR DELAY '00:00:00.50' -- Wait for 5 ms
           GOTO RETRY  -- Go to Label RETRY
       END
   END
   ELSE
   BEGIN
       RAISERROR(@ErrorMessage, 18, 1)
   END
  End Catch
 End

Name: tr_RMSTMP_InventoryMovement
trg_InventoryTransferLog_ItemLogs
Definition:
CREATE TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_InventoryTransferLog_ItemLogs]
   ON [dbo].[InventoryTransferLog]
   AFTER INSERT
AS BEGIN
    --SET NOCOUNT ON;    

		declare @status int
		declare @type int
		declare @ID int
		declare @Ponumber int

		set @ID = (Select top 1 i.ReferenceID  from Inserted i)
		set @type = (Select top 1 p.POType from Inserted i inner join PurchaseOrder p on i.ReferenceID = p.id where p.id = @ID )
		set @Ponumber = (Select top 1 p.id from Inserted i inner join PurchaseOrder p on i.ReferenceID = p.id where p.id = @ID )

			insert into SOD_Item_Logs(ItemID,ItemLookupCode,[Type],ReferenceID ,QuantityORIS ,LastQuantity,NewQuantity,LastCommitted,NewCommitted,Date)
			(

			select i.ID,i.ItemLookupCode,
			case
				when @type = 0 then 'Purchase Order Logs'
				when @type = 2 then 'Transfer In Logs'
				when @type = 3 then 'Transfer Out Logs'
				else '-'
				end,@Ponumber ,n.Quantity , 
				case
				when @type = 0 then i.Quantity - n.Quantity    -- PurchaseOrder
				when @type = 2 then i.Quantity - n.Quantity     -- Transfer In
				when @type = 3 then i.Quantity + (n.Quantity * -1)   -- Transfer Out
				else 0
				end ,
				case
				when @type = 0 then i.Quantity   -- PurchaseOrder
				when @type = 2 then i.Quantity   -- Transfer In
				when @type = 3 then (i.Quantity - n.Quantity) + n.Quantity   -- Transfer Out
				else 0
				end
				,i.QuantityCommitted,i.QuantityCommitted, GEtdate()
			from inserted n
			inner join item i on n.ItemID = i.id
			)
   
		

END

Name: trg_ItemLogs
Definition:
create TRIGGER [dbo].[trg_ItemLogs]
   ON [dbo].[Item]
   AFTER UPDATE
AS BEGIN
    SET NOCOUNT ON;    

	insert into SOD_Item_Logs(ItemID,ItemLookupCode,[Type],ReferenceID ,QuantityORIS ,LastQuantity,NewQuantity,LastCommitted,NewCommitted,Date)
	(
	select i.ID,i.ItemLookupCode,'Item Auto Logs','-',d.Quantity - n.Quantity,d.Quantity,n.Quantity ,d.QuantityCommitted,n.QuantityCommitted , GEtdate()
	from item i
	inner join inserted n on i.id = n.id
	inner join deleted d on i.id = d.id
	)
   
END
